worksheet.title: Unit Economics Worksheet
worksheet.description: Run the numbers on each shortlisted idea to find out which ones can actually make money.

fields.label: Idea name
fields.helpText: Auto-filled from your Chapter 3 shortlist. Rename it there if you want to change it.

fields.label: Product cost per unit
fields.helpText: What you pay the supplier per unit. Use real quotes where possible.

fields.label: Shipping to customer
fields.helpText: Cost to send one order to the buyer. Include packaging materials.

fields.label: Platform fees (% or fixed)
fields.helpText: Marketplace or store fees per sale. E.g. '10% Etsy' or '£2.50 fixed'.

fields.label: Intended selling price
fields.helpText: What you plan to charge the customer.

fields.label: Margin per unit
fields.helpText: Selling price minus all costs. Calculate this yourself: is it enough to advertise profitably?

fields.label: Variant complexity
fields.helpText: How many SKUs would you need to stock at launch?

fields.label: Decision
fields.helpText: Based on the numbers, does this idea pass the economics test?

fields.label: Your chosen idea
fields.helpText: Select the idea that passed both the demand test (Chapter 3) and the numbers test.

fields.label: Why this idea
fields.helpText: In a sentence or two: why does this idea have better economics than the others?
